# OS Technology

> UK-based managed IT services provider (MSP) and certified Microsoft 365 partner, offering IT support for home users and growing businesses across East Riding of Yorkshire and the UK.

OS Technology provides remote-first IT support with no call centres and no jargon. Services include Microsoft 365 deployment and migration, cybersecurity auditing, device procurement, web presence management, virtual CIO consultancy, and fully managed IT support plans (Starter, Standard, Premium).

## Key Pages

- [Home – UK Based IT Support & Managed IT Services](https://ostechnology.uk/): Overview of OS Technology's home and business IT services, support plans and coverage area.
- [About OS Technology](https://ostechnology.uk/about): Who we are, how we work, and why we are remote-first.
- [Partners](https://ostechnology.uk/partners): Microsoft licensing, ThreatDown endpoint security and Ironscales email protection.

## Services

- [Home IT Support Services](https://ostechnology.uk/services/home): IT support for home users — device setup, troubleshooting, security and backup.
- [Business IT Services](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business): Index of managed services for growing UK businesses.
- [Managed IT Support for Business](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/it-support): Fully managed IT support plans (Starter, Standard, Premium).
- [Microsoft Modern Workplace (Microsoft 365 & Copilot AI)](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/modern-workplace): Microsoft 365 deployment, migration and Copilot adoption.
- [Business Cybersecurity](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/cybersecurity): Endpoint protection, email security, auditing and staff awareness.
- [Device Support & Procurement](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/device-support): Ongoing support and lifecycle management for business devices.
- [New Device Provision](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/new-devices): Sourcing, configuring and deploying new business hardware.
- [Web Presence & Hosting](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/web-presence): Websites, domains, hosting and business email.
- [Virtual CIO (vCIO)](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/vcio): Technology roadmapping, IT budget planning, vendor management and quarterly business reviews.

## Local & Industry Landing Pages

- [Areas We Cover – IT Support Across East Riding](https://ostechnology.uk/locations): Index of location pages.
- [Industries We Support – Sector IT Support](https://ostechnology.uk/industries): Index of industry pages.

OS Technology publishes location-specific IT support pages for towns across the East Riding of Yorkshire (Hull, Beverley, Bridlington, Goole, Driffield, Cottingham, Hessle, Pocklington, Withernsea, Hedon, Howden and Market Weighton) at https://ostechnology.uk/locations, and industry-specific pages for office-based sectors (accountants, solicitors, estate agents, financial advisers, recruitment agencies, architects, insurance brokers, marketing agencies and charities) at https://ostechnology.uk/industries. Industry pages cover the IT foundation OS Technology manages — Microsoft 365, devices, cybersecurity and backup — not third-party line-of-business software, which is supported by its own vendors.
